hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && LC_ALL=C grep -q $'\xe2\x80\x94' "$f"; then printf "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Em dash found in %s. This project forbids em dashes: use a colon, a semicolon, parentheses, or reword.\"}" "$f"; fi
